dct_title_s: Adolph Quadrangle, Minnesota, 1953: 7.5 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Adolph quadrangle topographic map (N4645-W9215/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in red ink and pencil regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the area between Esko and Twig. The hand written notations include information on the following: Minnesota and Northwestern Railroad line and logging camps noted with 'C'.
